purpose: Prevent regressions where Aracne speech is not visibly transcribed, not persisted to the travel booklet, or route weaving is not visible during speech.

expect: the complete answer is rendered in assistantResultText before speech synthesis starts
the answer card scrolls into view
when a route answer starts speaking the assistant modal may close
the complete answer remains visible in the floating Aracne speech ribbon over the map
the ribbon remains until speech finishes and briefly afterwards
Aracne answers are written to aracne_journal_notes immediately
opening the travel booklet re-renders stored entries
invalid stored JSON does not break the app
storage quota fallback preserves textual entries even if proof images must be discarded
route weaving starts from the speech onstart lifecycle
the spider marker moves along the route while speech is active
weave duration is estimated from answer length rather than fixed at 2.9 seconds
speech end restores the normal route and removes the temporary weaving overlay
if speech synthesis is unavailable, afterAnswer still reveals and weaves the route
if mobile WebKit does not fire speech onstart promptly, the 900 ms fallback starts the route reveal
